description: Les emplacements de stationnement PMR à Roubaix is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Roubaix. Coverage: Ville de Roubaix. The portal shows the English title as "PMR parking spaces in Roubaix" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Roubaix. Its keywords include stationnement, handicap. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
